{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Linux-Build

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - '.github/workflows/windows-build.yml'
      - '.gitignore'
      - 'LICENSE'
      - 'README.md'

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-26.04]
        arch: [x86_64]
        mode: [debug, releasedbg]

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'ci skip')"

    env:
      OBS_VERSION: '33.0.0'
      CMAKE_PRESET: 'ubuntu'

    steps:
    - name: Get current date as package key
      id: pkg_key
      run: echo "key=$(date +'%W')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Checkout Kinect SDKs
      uses: actions/checkout@v7
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        repository: SirLynix/kinect-sdks
        token: ${{ secrets.KINECT_SDKS_PAT }}
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/kinect-sdks

    # Install OBS studio & Kinect for Azure dependencies
    - name: Install apt dependencies
      run: | 
          sudo apt-get -qq update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
          cmake extra-cmake-modules ninja-build pkg-config clang clang-format build-essential curl ccache git zsh \
          libavcodec-dev libavdevice-dev libavfilter-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswresample-dev libswscale-dev libx264-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libmbedtls-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libjansson-dev libluajit-5.1-dev python3-dev libx11-dev libxcb-randr0-dev libxcb-shm0-dev libxcb-xinerama0-dev libxcb-composite0-dev libxcomposite-dev libxinerama-dev libxcb1-dev libx11-xcb-dev libxcb-xfixes0-dev swig libcmocka-dev libxss-dev libglvnd-dev libgles2-mesa-dev libwayland-dev librist-dev libsrt-openssl-dev libpci-dev libpipewire-0.3-dev libqrcodegencpp-dev uthash-dev libsimde-dev \
          libdrm-dev uuid-dev

    # Cache OBS Studio
    - name: Retrieve OBS Studio cache
      uses: actions/cache@v6
      id: obs-cache
      with:
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/obs-studio
        key: Linux-OBS-Studio-${{ env.OBS_VERSION }}

    # Build obs-studio
    - name: Clone OBS
      if: steps.obs-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      uses: actions/checkout@v7
      with:
        repository: obsproject/obs-studio
        path: ${{ github.workspace }}/obs-studio
        submodules: 'recursive'
        fetch-depth: 0 # for tags

    # Checkout OBS to the wanted version
    - name: Checkout OBS-Studio release (${{ env.OBS_VERSION }})
      if: steps.obs-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/obs-studio
      run: |
        git checkout ${{ env.OBS_VERSION }}
        git submodule update

    # Configure and build obs
    - name: Build OBS-Studio
      if: steps.obs-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/obs-studio
      shell: bash
      run: |
        mkdir ./build64
        cd ./build64
        cmake -DENABLE_FRONTEND=OFF -DENABLE_SCRIPTING=OFF -DENABLE_CORE_MODULES=OFF -DENABLE_PULSEAUDIO=OFF -DENABLE_WAYLAND=OFF ..
        make -j4 libobs

    # Prepare environment
    - name: Configure build
      run:
        printf "LibObs = {\n  Include = [[${{ github.workspace }}/obs-studio/libobs]],\n  Build64 = [[${{ github.workspace }}/obs-studio/build64]]\n}\n\nObsPlugins={}" > config.lua

    # Force xmake to a specific folder (for cache)
    - name: Set xmake env
      run: echo "XMAKE_GLOBALDIR=${{ runner.workspace }}/xmake-global" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    # Install xmake
    - name: Setup xmake
      uses: xmake-io/github-action-setup-xmake@v1

    # Update xmake repository (in order to have the file that will be cached)
    - name: Update xmake repository
      run: xmake repo --update

    # Fetch xmake dephash
    - name: Retrieve dependencies hash
      id: dep_hash
      run: echo "hash=$(xmake l utils.ci.packageskey)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    # Cache xmake dependencies
    - name: Retrieve cached xmake dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v6
      with:
        path: ${{ env.XMAKE_GLOBALDIR }}/.xmake/packages
        key: Linux-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}-${{ steps.dep_hash.outputs.hash }}-W${{ steps.pkg_key.outputs.key }}

    # Setup compilation mode and install project dependencies
    - name: Configure xmake and install dependencies
      run: xmake config --arch=${{ matrix.arch }} --mode=${{ matrix.mode }} --ccache=n --yes --verbose
      env:
        KINECTSDKAZUREBT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/kinect-sdks/k4abt

    # Build the plugin
    - name: Build obs-kinect
      run: xmake --verbose
      env:
        KINECTSDKAZUREBT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/kinect-sdks/k4abt

    # Install the result files
    - name: Package obs-kinect
      run: xmake pack --verbose -y -f targz -o packaged
      env:
        KINECTSDKAZUREBT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/kinect-sdks/k4abt

    # Upload artifacts
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
      with:
        name: obs-kinect-linux-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}
        path: packaged",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a matrix build (debug and releasedbg modes) with no job timeout. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern supports bounding jobs with a custom timeout to prevent runaway consumption, and its precondition (representative successful-duration history exists) is met by the CI history showing runs completing in roughly 2.5-6.6 minutes. Adding timeout-minutes: 60 provides ample operational headroom (about 9x the slowest observed run) without skipping any build steps, tests, or artifacts, so intended build and test coverage is preserved. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or new network access are added, and no publishing/deployment operations are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
